datasets.description: Manual pilot documents in the development split. The extraction run is the five-document 8192-token pilot.
limitations: 35 development documents come from one manual import. 15 evaluation-split documents in that same file are counted and their text is not exported.
Extraction ran on 5 development seats, not on every development document.
Saved run timestamps use a fixed date and are not treated as the wall-clock time of the live call.

datasets.description: Partial YouTube comment sample from the 2026-10-03 research batch. It is outside the frozen split.
limitations: 20 comments from one video. Collection stopped during Dottotech's video. Howfinity's video was not started.
One thread with five replies was fetched to completion. The video-level report stays incomplete.
This sample is not added to the 35-document pilot and does not change the frozen split.
Nineteen relevance decisions are out of scope and one is adjacent. That adjacent classification is not an approved known-item episode. Its extraction attempt failed and saved no case.
Saved decision timestamps are not the 3 October wall-clock time.

not_combined: The 50-row, 22-row, and 35-row pilot imports overlap. This export reads the 50-row import once and keeps the development split only.
The 2026-10-02 YouTube collection saved one comment from two videos and is not merged into the 20-comment batch.
semantic_risks: retrieval_trigger must be the stated reason the item was needed, not the search method
impact and severity need a quote that states that impact or severity
problem_summary evidence must support every factual clause
quotes must be one continuous span; invented, abbreviated, or spliced text is invalid
